name_reason: Compliant game-global name: data_fd2_ prefix, battle domain (battle pathfind state table, qualifies for data_fd2_battle_*), descriptor pathfind_dst_y reflects purpose (pathfind destination Y coordinate) and is a scalar byte. The 'y' suffix is the coordinate axis (paired with dst_x), not a Ghidra address residue. No domain-ID stripping needed.
purpose: Pathfind destination tile Y (target row): the goal-tile row for the path-aware search fd2_pathfind_to_destination; compared against the current search position's Y to detect arrival at the destination.
logic_summary: Scalar uint8, second field of the destination-coord pair dst_x(0x60071)/dst_y(0x60072). Written only by fd2_pathfind_to_destination at entry from its dst_y (f2) argument truncated to low byte (MOV [0x60072],AL at 0x4E1DE); the plain flood-fill orchestrator never sets it. Read 8-bit by fd2_pathfind_check_destination_save_path (CMP DH,[0x60072] at 0x4E409) where DH is the current search Y, to decide whether the search has reached the destination row. BSS, zero at load, write-before-read.
datatype: uint8 (byte, 1 B); Ghidra DataDB byte len=1
element_semantics: Single scalar: destination tile Y / target row coordinate (0..map_height-1). Not an array (0x60071 is the separate dst_x, 0x60073 the output-buffer pointer).
comment_original_issue: src comment block (pathfnd.c lines 863-875) is already accurate and precise (correct widths, exact writer/reader addresses 0x4E1DE/0x4E409, scalar-not-array note). No issue; kept. Separately, the Ghidra side had its doc in the wrong field (PRE_COMMENT not PLATE_COMMENT) and that PRE text carried a stale 'emit_action = emit_c_const' line which is incorrect (a game WRITE-xref at 0x4E1DE exists, so the global is mutable/non-const); fixed by migrating to PLATE_COMMENT with corrected non-const wording and clearing the stale PRE_COMMENT.
notes: Verified 2 xrefs match src/plate exactly: WRITE 0x4E1DE (MOV [0x00060072],AL; AL from EBP+0x20 = 8th cdecl arg dst_y, src line 702 data_fd2_battle_pathfind_dst_y=(uint8)f2) and READ 0x4E409 (CMP DH,[0x00060072] in fd2_pathfind_check_destination_save_path, src line 515 y==data_fd2_battle_pathfind_dst_y). Memory at 0x60072 = 0 (BSS, runtime-populated). const-ness: game-side WRITE present -> non-const, matches src emit as plain non-const uint8 (line 875). Sibling dst_x @ 0x60071 was already migrated to PLATE_COMMENT by a prior refiner; this brings dst_y to the same convention.
